tasks.title: Slint shell + state bindings over ephemera-core

done: Created crates/ephemera-app: standalone Slint shell crate (own workspace + Cargo.lock), depends only on ephemera-core and slint 1.17.

ui/app.slint: 1280x860 shell window with chrome, KPI stat tiles, RAM/Disk placeholder panes (PaneCard/DiskCard), Database/Cloud placeholder sink panels, and the full state-model property set mirroring src/store/useAppStore.ts.

src/model.rs: ShellState UI-layer store (ram/disk/db/cloud lists, metrics, 60s history ring, db/cloud statuses, vault path) projected into Slint properties. Metadata only — no file bytes in any UI-layer struct or Slint property.

src/main.rs: single-process wiring — AppState built on a tokio runtime, 4Hz metrics sampler and 5s db/cloud poller marshalled to the UI thread via slint::invoke_from_event_loop, refresh-all Slint callback handled by direct core calls (no IPC).
cargo check, cargo build, cargo clippy --all-targets -D warnings, cargo fmt --check all green; 4 unit tests pass; debug binary launches on Wayland and stays alive.
